heading: Legal Notice & Disclaimer
body:

If you have an issue requiring legal advice, please contact your attorney directly. You should not make legal hiring decisions based on promotional materials.

If you desire to engage the services of an attorney at Elliott, Ostrander & Preston, P.C., please contact the firm and discuss your needs with the appropriate attorney licensed in your state. No attorney-client relationship will be created until you and we sign an agreement to act as your lawyer. Our principal office is located in Portland, Oregon; however, we also have attorneys licensed in other states.
